versions.duplicateResolution: Claude uses the shared .agents skill symlink; the separate Claude plugin was not installed, so no same-provider plugin-plus-manual duplicate was introduced.

triggers: Design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, simplify, harden, animate, or improve a frontend interface.
Websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, components, forms, settings, onboarding, empty states, and native iOS or Android screens.

supportedTech.templateEngineNote: Astro, Vue, and Svelte source files are supported; opting into the static HTML engine for these templates trades regex rules and source line numbers for element-level checks.
supportedTech.urlScan: Supported by the engine; requires a compatible installed browser. This run tested local static files only.

directLauncher.purpose: load project context once per session
deterministic rendered URL analysis when a browser is available
analyze an attached desktop browser page

commands.determinism: detect is a deterministic engine command. Skill workflows such as critique, audit, polish, and shape are prompt instructions interpreted by a provider model; they are not standalone deterministic programs.

dependencies.nativeSkillRuntime: No Node runtime required for the skill launcher.
dependencies.engine: Self-contained platform binary; launcher version-pins it and requires a matching SHA-256 sidecar for a fresh download.
dependencies.firstUseNetwork: Official GitHub release access is needed when no compatible binary is available in the skill tree or user cache.
dependencies.sourceBuild: Build tooling is separate from use: Node >=18.19.0, Bun 1.3.13, Rust/Cargo.

engineRelease.updatedLauncherChecksumGate: passed using the official checksum-verified asset staged under a temporary file:// release base; the binary was cached only under a /tmp IMPECCABLE_HOME
engineRelease.runtimeConclusion: The binary runs, but the published 0.1.16 binary predates the pinned source commit that adds the linked-stylesheet ignore fix.

verification.officialLicenseAndProviderFormats: verified from pinned LICENSE, package.json, README, and provider trees
verification.providerTreeComparison: passed: .agents tree 62/62 files and OpenCode tree 57/57 files match the pinned provider trees

detectorOperationalCheck.fixture: Temporary local HTML page with a linked vendor stylesheet; detector.ignoreFiles was set to src/vendor/**.
detectorOperationalCheck.regressionExpected: The linked stylesheet's gradient-text page-level finding is waived while low-contrast remains because the stylesheet still styles the page.
detectorOperationalCheck.regressionObserved: Both page-level findings remain with detector.ignoreFiles configured; the direct scan of the ignored CSS file is suppressed.

sourceRegressionTest.reason: Cargo is not installed; no toolchain was installed.

providerRuntimeDiscovery.codex: impeccable appeared in the current injected skill catalog before the update; a fresh runtime reload after the file update was not performed.
providerRuntimeDiscovery.claudeCode: The native .claude/skills path resolves to the updated shared .agents tree; no fresh Claude model invocation was performed.
providerRuntimeDiscovery.openCode: The native user skill directory and front matter are present on disk; no OpenCode runtime discovery command or model invocation was performed.
providerRuntimeDiscovery.claudePlugin: No matching installation was found in the inspected Claude plugin directory; the official plugin was not installed.

update.method: Copy only the six changed non-SKILL provider files from the matching official 4.7 provider tree; update each provider's version field while preserving its native metadata; no installer or plugin command was run.
semanticChanges: Updated line-break guidance in typeset reference.
Updated launcher cleans staged files on termination.
Updated live mode improves touch behavior and plain-HTTP session/clipboard fallback.

rollback.restoreInstructions: Restore 7 backed-up files from agents/ to ~/.agents/skills/impeccable/ and 7 from opencode/ to ~/.config/opencode/skills/impeccable/. The Claude symlink follows the restored .agents tree.

limitations: The published engine-v0.1.16 binary predates the pinned source commit; its runtime detector does not implement the linked stylesheet ignore behavior present in pinned source.
The pinned source regression test was not run because Cargo is unavailable.
Fresh Claude and OpenCode runtime discovery after the update is unverified; filesystem discovery is not proof of runtime reload.
The detector was exercised only on a temporary static fixture, not a production URL or rendered browser session.
Prompt-based critique and audit workflows were not invoked; their output is provider-model behavior, not a deterministic analysis result.
